info.name: Rentora Sphere API - Production V1
info.description:
### Rentora Sphere Real Estate Management System
This API handles the core business logic for property management, including user authentication, unit inventory, and lease contracts.

**Base URLs:**
- Production: `https://rentorasphere-production-cba2.up.railway.app/api/`
- Development: `http://localhost:5001/api/` 

**Authentication:**
Most endpoints require a Bearer Token obtained from the `/users/login` endpoint. Ensure the `token` variable is set in your environment.

item.name: User Identity & Access
item.description: Endpoints related to user lifecycle: registration, session management, and profile updates.

request.description:
Creates a new user account in the system. 
**Note:** Registration is public and does not require a token.
Authenticates user and returns a JWT. The script automatically updates the `token` environment variable on success.

item.name: Property Units
item.description: Management of physical assets (apartments, villas, etc.).

request.description: Retrieves a list of all available properties. Supports pagination and filtering (to be implemented).

item.name: Lease Contracts
item.description: Handles legal agreements between users and units.

request.description: Initiates a contract request for a specific unit. Requires `unitId` in the body and `token` in headers.
